scope: Prospective operational scheduling for the complete later model and source controls. No baseline changes, feature extraction or control fitting is dispatched by this record.
review_basis: Separate code reviews of memory lifetime, protocol compatibility and controller batch boundaries. Approval here records this operational review, not a claim of user sign-off or scientific completion.
supersedes_only: The preserved source resource-decision decision.maximum_concurrent_fits=1, for the still-pending final control execution. All scientific choices, ten Rv masks, ten Rp masks, all original seeds and all prepared source bytes remain unchanged.

model_draft_edit.status: The model protocol remains a draft pending baseline completion and final extraction/release locks.

allocation.exclusive_rule: Every cell whose vision model is moco OR whose text model is elmo runs alone for its entire five-method process.
allocation.shared_rule: The remaining six vision/text combinations and every source mask/seed job may share an adjacent batch.
allocation.order: Use the complete unchanged derived job order. Admit only the first one or two pending jobs. Never skip an exclusive job or cross replay/expanded/source boundaries. Drain every job and descendant in a batch before strict readers.
allocation.reference_replays: The five reference cells run in batches of two, two and one. All five must agree with the original baseline at the existing absolute 1e-10 retrieval tolerance before any expanded fit.

capacity.evidence: The preserved source resource decision binds five-second samples from one completed full original run and part of the next: about 6.65-6.80 GiB summed process RSS. Those observations are not a peak bound for later controls.

preflight_memory_review.validation: feature_paths calls validate_tensor sequentially for all 14 entries and retains only paths. Each validator holds one memory-mapped tensor and checks 512-row blocks. Fitting banks are constructed afterward.
preflight_memory_review.lifetime_limits: Mapped pages, Python metadata and allocator arenas may remain resident temporarily. Reclaimable filesystem cache is shared, and summed RSS can double-count shared pages. There is no code-level retention of all fourteen tensor objects.

capacity.limits: Planning allowances, not measured upper bounds. Library workspace, copies and allocator behavior can vary. Two processes may contend for the 16 logical CPUs; faster completion and numerical equivalence are not assumed.
capacity.shortfall_policy: Recheck available capacity before final execution. Insufficient capacity delays admission or requires additional capacity, never fewer models, seeds, masks, rows, methods or iterations.

controller_review.finding: No concrete blocker found for this policy in the reviewed code.
covered_by_existing_artificial_tests: valid artifacts with a failed service
coverage_limits: No complete model-to-source transition is exercised by the current artificial suite.
The test named with_four checks absence of the replay gate; it does not construct four complete replays.
No live two-job scientific execution or measured concurrent numerical comparison has been performed.

required_before_first_control_fit: Complete and verify all five original baseline runs and the frozen comparison.
Freeze the final model protocol/extraction release before all ten added feature extractions; verify all outputs and the complete 14-entry feature lock.
Bind this amendment, resource policy, both scientific protocols, all inputs, exact prepared source closure, full schedule, code closure and private binding hashes in the final execution lock.
Issue a truthful, reviewed prior-work quiescence receipt after checking actual processes; the original baseline, extraction and unrelated work must not overlap control jobs.
Validate the final release and empty attempt-tree reader checks before dispatch.
failure_policy: Stop new dispatch after any verified failure; allow an active sibling to finish. Preserve every attempt, with no timeout kill, automatic retry or score-based replacement. Any execution or policy change requires an explicit reviewed record before further dispatch.
